1047072.name: Maayon Yisroel
1047072.note: Rabbi Reuven Wolf's speaker bio: 'Maayon Yisroel was founded in 2006 by Rabbi Wolf and Haki Abhesera' (the same bio on YouTube); a 2013 version says 2008, and therebbesimpact.com gives 2008-2009, so medium. Checked (Nov 6): no independent second source found. Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 158 South Detroit Street, Los Angeles (Feb 2010, Sept 2014); it is now at 140 North La Brea Avenue, Los Angeles, listed there by Jan 2018, so it moved there between Sept 2014 and Jan 2018.

earlier.where: 158 South Detroit Street, Los Angeles (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Feb 9 2010 to Sept 5 2014)

3331323.name: Chabad of Hollywood West
3331323.note: The center's own post, June 27 2026: 'Today we celebrate 10 incredible years' since Rabbi Yossi and Rebbetzin Geula Dalfin arrived in West Hollywood; therebbesimpact.com and the listing number agree (2016). Archived copies of its chabad.org listing (Wayback Machine) show it at 967 North La Cienega Boulevard, Los Angeles (Aug 2019); it is now at 933 North Crescent Heights Boulevard, Los Angeles, so it moved there after Aug 2019 (when, not found).

earlier.where: 967 North La Cienega Boulevard, Los Angeles (its address on its chabad.org listing as archived Aug 24 2019)
